title: Risk alert: flood – Guangdong
text: Severe flooding in Guangdong has disrupted factories around Shenzhen and Dongguan; operations are expected to be halted for 3 weeks.

title: Sub-tier sourcing: Rotorix Motors
text: According to the supplier audit, Rotorix Motors procures copper windings from Baltic Copper, based in Gdansk. Baltic Copper operates its main plant in Gdansk.

title: Risk alert: earthquake – Kyushu
text: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck Kyushu on 2026-09-25. Plants in Kumamoto are expected to remain closed for about 6 weeks.

title: Analyst note: Brightway
text: Brightway's etching gases are shipped in from KSG, a specialty chemicals maker.

title: Analyst note: VCS
text: Most of the lithium hydroxide used by VCS originates at Kunlun Lithium Materials.

title: Risk alert: export restriction – Jiangxi
text: Authorities announced export restrictions on rare earth magnets from Jiangxi, effective 2026-10-02 and expected to last 12 weeks.

title: Risk alert: fire – Tijuana Harness Works S.A. de C.V.
text: A fire broke out at Tijuana Harness's Tijuana plant on 2026-10-05; the company estimates 4 weeks to restore full production.

title: Risk alert: port strike – Gdansk
text: Dock workers at the port of Gdansk began a strike on 2026-10-07; analysts expect 2 weeks of disruption to outbound cargo.

title: Risk alert: typhoon – Hsinchu
text: A typhoon made landfall near Hsinchu on 2026-10-09; fabs in Hsinchu expect 2 weeks before output normalises.
